name: Vib Project Manifest Schema
description: Official schema for vibproject.ygit project manifests.

properties.name: $schema
properties.description: Canonical VPMS Version 1 schema URL.

properties.name: schemaVersion
properties.description: Schema major version; must equal 1.

properties.name: manifestVersion
properties.description: VPMS Version 1 manifest format version.

properties.name: project
properties.description: Project identity and core metadata.

properties.name: organization
properties.description: Ownership, maintainers, contributors, and contact details.

properties.name: repository
properties.description: Repository provider, URLs, and branches.

properties.name: branding
properties.description: Product naming and branding asset paths.

properties.name: license
properties.description: License name, SPDX identifier, and file.

properties.name: technology
properties.description: Languages, frameworks, libraries, databases, and APIs.

properties.name: platform
properties.description: Supported desktop, mobile, server, web, and operating systems.

properties.name: runtime
properties.description: Runtime version constraints and container requirements.

properties.name: entrypoints
properties.description: Application, CLI, GUI, API, documentation, and test entry points.

properties.name: paths
properties.description: Canonical repository paths.

properties.name: dependencies
properties.description: Required, optional, and external service dependencies.

properties.name: documentation
properties.description: Documentation files, roots, and website.

properties.name: build
properties.description: Build system, package formats, and commands.

properties.name: release
properties.description: Release strategy and latest version.

properties.name: quality
properties.description: Formatter, linter, tests, coverage, and security tooling.

properties.name: automation
properties.description: CI/CD workflows and scheduled tasks.

properties.name: ai
properties.description: AI repository-context capabilities.

properties.name: metadata
properties.description: Manifest timestamps, author, generator, and specification metadata.

description: Official schema for vibtools.json manifests to automate project imports, catalogs, social OG preview cards, and non-technical user documentation.

properties.name: $schema
properties.description: Canonical VibTools Version 1 schema URL.

properties.name: name
properties.description: Product display name.

properties.name: slug
properties.description: Unique URL slug identifier.

properties.name: category
properties.description: Product catalog category.

properties.name: status
properties.description: Release or availability status.

properties.name: version
properties.description: Current release version.

properties.name: subtitle
properties.description: Primary tag or subtitle summary.

properties.name: repository
properties.description: GitHub repository path or URL.

properties.name: description
properties.description: Comprehensive product description.

properties.name: assets
properties.description: Logos, social OG image cards (1200x630), banners, and screenshots.

properties.name: documents
properties.description: Paths to non-technical user guides: quick-start, features, FAQ, and what's new.

properties.name: links
properties.description: Download link, live demo, docs, and repo links.

properties.name: tags
properties.description: Keywords and filter tags array.

properties.name: flags
properties.description: Active, open-source, and featured highlight flags.

properties.description: Custom vendor-specific extensions.
